subject: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>, Fincobank Security Ops <security-ops@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)

Thanks again for the call earlier, Priya - good to meet the security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you the audit evidence you need to complete your review.

Recap (what we covered)
- Redwood can provide event-level audit exports showing who accessed what and when (API requests, console actions, model exports).
- Exports include timestamps, user identifiers, action types, resource identifiers, and metadata (IP, session id).
- We support CSV/JSON exports via secure SFTP or temporary Drive links; retention policies are configurable per-account.

Requested deliverables / next steps
1) Jordan (me) - provide an example export (sample rows) and the export schema.
2) Marissa - prepare an export covering last 90 days with the columns we discussed and a short note on retention/archival.
3) Ben - prepare an access matrix showing roles with log access and procedures for privileged access.
4) Priya - confirm any additional fields you need (e.g., device id, user agent) and preferred export method.

Attached: audit_logs_sample.csv (example rows), export_schema.pdf (field definitions)

Let me know if you'd like a short walkthrough once you review the sample.

--Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Fincobank Security Ops <security-ops@fincobank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)

Thanks Jordan - this looks good. A few follow-ups from our side so the evidence is review-ready: 

1) Retention: we need confirmation of how long raw audit logs are retained by default and details on how to configure retention for our account (we'd prefer 7 years for regulatory buckets).
2) PII: confirm whether any PII fields (user email, resource names) are redacted in standard exports or whether we provide a separate redaction step. We need to understand redaction options and whether redaction is reversible.
3) Access indicators: please ensure the export includes the mapped corporate user id (SAML/SSO identifier) and originating IP address for each event.
4) Export formats: CSV is fine; can you confirm column delimiter and whether timestamps are UTC ISO-8601? We also prefer a checksum for the file transfer.

If you can include a sample export with the fields above and an access matrix that lists who in Redwood can view unredacted logs, that would be ideal. Also share the secure upload method (SFTP user + expiry or a Drive link + ACL).

We can schedule a short follow-up next week to validate the sample.

--Priya
Priya Sharma
Sr. Manager, InfoSec
Fincobank
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)

Looping in to own the evidence pack. Proposed plan: 

- I'll generate a filtered export for the last 90 days with the following columns: event_timestamp (UTC ISO-8601), corporate_user_id (SAML id), action, resource_id, resource_type, ip_address, session_id, outcome (success/fail), truncated_pii_flag.
- We'll redact sensitive resource names by default in the public sample and provide a separate unredacted export (secure transfer) for your security review under an NDA if required. Redaction is irreversible on the redacted export; unredacted exports are generated only after an approved request tracked in our access matrix.
- I'll include a short note on retention configuration and the default retention policy (90 days raw, archival to cold storage configurable up to 7 years with enterprise contract).

Ben - can you create the access_matrix.xlsx with the following columns: role, role_description, has_unredacted_log_access (Y/N), access_approval_process, last_access_review_date. Send the draft and I'll attach it to the evidence pack.

I'll put the schema and sample on the shared Drive folder and post the link here when ready.

--Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>
Date: 2026-07-29T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)

Attached the access matrix and uploaded the full (redacted) sample export to the Drive folder. Links and files below: 

Attachments: access_matrix.xlsx
Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleLink (folder contains export_schema.pdf, audit_logs_sample.csv, access_matrix.xlsx)
Transfer / integrity: files include SHA256 checksum in the Drive README and we'll provide SFTP credentials for an encrypted transfer if preferred (we can generate one-time credentials valid 72 hours).

Notes: sample export uses comma delimiter, timestamps in UTC ISO-8601, and includes IP and SAML id fields. Redacted fields are marked with <REDACTED>. Let me know if you need a different column order.

--Ben
Ben Carter
Solution Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Sharma <priya@fincobank.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-30T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fincobank - audit logs & evidence (post-call + next steps)

Thanks all - I downloaded the sample and the access matrix. A few quick confirmations before we schedule the validation call: 

- The CSV looks good and includes the SAML id and IP address. We confirm timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.
- Can you add a column for "exported_by" (email) so we can see which Redwood user generated the export?
- We'd like the retention configuration statement in writing (what you said about default 90 days and the enterprise option up to 7 years). If you can drop a short PDF with that policy into the Drive folder, we'll include it in our evidence binder.

If you can add the exported_by column and the retention policy doc, let's schedule a 30-min call Thursday 11am PT to validate. 

--Priya
Priya Sharma
Sr. Manager, InfoSec
Fincobank
